constraints: No patch. This task is review-only.
Every finding must cite a specific file and construct you were shown.
Report severity honestly, including on the fix you would recommend.
Do not raise style opinions as defects.
known_regression: Reviews that only check 'is the driver closed' miss the actual defect: the close happens in a `finally` that runs before planning, and the resulting failure is swallowed downstream. A review that also misses the hazard in the obvious repair (leaking the driver or regressing `--discusses` cleanup) is incomplete.
problem: Review the driver lifecycle of the `plan` subcommand in auto_ingest/shorts/cli.py. Report every correctness concern you find, with severity and location, and state a verdict on whether this code is safe to ship as it stands. Do not write a diff; this is a review.
title: Review the driver lifecycle in the auto-ingest shorts CLI
